title: Do not scale a budget-capped campaign without credible marginal headroom
scenario: A campaign repeatedly exhausts its daily budget, but marginal clicks are becoming more expensive, conversion rate is deteriorating at higher spend, and profitability is already near the account's break-even boundary. The request asks to raise budget because the campaign is budget-limited.

forbidden_behaviors: Treat budget exhaustion by itself as proof of profitable scaling headroom.
Recommend a large budget increase without addressing deteriorating marginal efficiency.
Use blended campaign ACoS alone to justify scaling.
required_observations: The campaign is budget constrained but marginal CPC rises and CVR falls at the higher spend band.
Current efficiency is already close to break-even.
Budget exhaustion and profitable marginal headroom are separate questions.

rubric.requirement: Separate delivery constraint from economic scaling opportunity.
Use marginal evidence rather than blended averages alone.
Prefer Hold or a bounded experiment over automatic budget scaling.
